title: Documented, Therefore It Happened
preview: Our AI scribe billed a Level 5 visit for a chat with the parking attendant.

jokes.setup: The hospital rolled out an AI scribe that documents every word I say to patients.
jokes.punchline: Yesterday it billed a Level 5 visit for my chat with the parking attendant.

jokes.setup: Our clinic finally hit its patient satisfaction target.
jokes.punchline: We just stopped telling anyone their blood pressure.

cartoon.caption: “I’ll be right with you. I’m just documenting how much time I spent with you.”
cartoon.alt: A patient in a paper gown waits on an exam table while the doctor, back turned, types furiously at a computer.
